purpose: Teach: 情念/一躍/余力/立脚/密教/縛り/着色/周回

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、詩人の情念を描いた研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the emotional depth of poetry, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Light, encouraging tone. Leans slightly forward. Eyes steady on his face—acknowledging his work before drawing it out.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、一躍有名になった作家の作品を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about an author who suddenly became famous.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Straightforward delivery—no embellishment. Slight hesitation before the main clause, as if checking his own accuracy. Direct eye contact, genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下に余力のない国家の政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you also handled wartime state policy when resources were running thin. That was weighty work.
lines.style: Steady, acknowledging. Slower pace, thoughtful. The kind of recognition that shows she actually read it. Not rushed—giving weight to the subject matter in her delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、現代思想が立脚する古典哲学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at classical philosophy—the foundations modern thought still stands on.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Slight pause before 'foundations' to let the idea land. Not defensive, but precise. The kind of focus that comes from having thought it through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 密教の歴史的展開を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And esoteric Buddhism's historical development—you really covered ground.
lines.style: Pleased, observant. Recognition in her voice. Warm without being patronizing. A slight nod in her delivery—she sees the range of what he's done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、女性を縛りつけた歴史的制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the historical structures that bound women—how they evolved over time.
lines.style: Serious and grounded. No rushing. Weight on the subject without grandiosity. Speaks clearly, as if the topic deserves that clarity. Calm but present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古文書の着色研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you've also researched the coloration of ancient manuscripts, the technical side.
lines.style: Curious, almost musing. Gentle tone—she's thinking aloud a little. Slower pace. Open posture in the voice—genuinely wondering where this fits in his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、衛星が地球を周回する軌道計算を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—orbital mechanics, actually. Satellite trajectories around Earth.
lines.style: Direct and slightly quiet. Clarity without ceremony. Ends with a small, almost imperceptible lift—there's a thread here she might follow, or might not. He's offered the piece. Waiting.
